Hotobak(Background Music)
Hotobak – a unique service which allows you to personalize a telephone call with sounds/noises/music to be played in the background. You just need to activate the service and choose a sound effect or music tune which you wants to hear while having the telephone conversation.
How to use Hotobak
Call 16480 and select Hotobak service from the main menu
You have to subscribe the service first, (3 days free trial ) press 1 for daily plan (charge – Tk 2), press 2 for weekly plan (charge – Tk 12) & press 3 for Monthly plan (charge-Tk 50) – all prices are excluding VAT+SD+SC (call charges are applicable)
After successful subscriptions call 16480 again and select Hotobak service from the main menu,
Press 1 to dial the number you wish to call / Press 2 to listen to the available music/sounds available and to set the default keypad for your favorites / Press 9 to manage your subscription (to unsubscribe press 1 after 9)
If you pressed 1 - Enter the number you wish to dial followed by the # key
Press 1 to confirm the number
When the call is connected, dial keys 1 to 9 for different back ground music/sound
Press # to decrease volume
Press * to increase volume
Press 0 to stop music/sounds
Press 0 or 1-9 to start again.
